executor_description: Start a WhatsApp conversation to (new) contacts by sending a pre approved message template. See https://help.trengo.com/en/articles/296134-adding-whatsapp-templates-via-trengo for more info.

recipient_phone_number.description:
Only required if `ticket_id` is not set. This should be a valid phone number and must be a valid WhatsApp number.

`Example: "+31620000000`

hsm_id.description: The WhatsApp template ID. *How to find the WhatsApp template ID; navigate to the template in the Trengo settings -> ID is in the URL

params.description: Message params. This is an array of parameter objects that replace placeholders in the template. Each object must contain type, key, and value.

type.description:
Parameter type. Valid values: `body`, `header`,  `button`,  or `otp`.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `body` | Parameters that replace `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, etc. in the template body text |
| `header` | Media parameters for templates with image, video, or document headers |
| `button` | **NEW** - Parameters for dynamic URL buttons containing `{{1}}` placeholders |
| `otp` | One-time password for authentication templates |

key.description:
The format depends on the parameter `type`:

| Type | Key Format | Examples |
|------|------------|----------|
| `body` | Placeholder number in `{{n}}` format, or just the integer | `"{{1}}"`, `"{{2}}"`, or `1`, `2` |
| `header` | Media type matching the template header | `"image"`, `"video"`, `"document"` |
| `button` | Zero-based button index as a string | `"0"` (first button), `"1"` (second button) |
| `otp` | Always `"{{1}}"` | `"{{1}}"` |

value.description:
The value depends on the parameter `type`:

| Type | Value Description |
|------|-------------------|
| `body` | The text that replaces the placeholder. Cannot contain newlines, tabs, or more than 4 consecutive spaces. |
| `header` | For media headers: the numeric file ID. For text headers: the text value (max 60 chars). |
| `button` | The URL path segment to append. Will be trimmed of whitespace. Cannot be empty. |
| `otp` | The one-time password code to send. |
